title: Design System: การบ้านหลังนวด

brand.displayName: เขียวใบแค Leaf Green

headline.purpose: Page titles, shell product name, success headline, 1669 button.

action.purpose: Labels on the largest primary buttons, display face.

title.purpose: Section headings, yes/no labels, repetition counter.

question.purpose: The symptom question, set as the screen h1.

body-lg.purpose: Flag messages, panel values, emphasised notices.

label.purpose: Metadata lines, dt labels, day labels.

caption.purpose: Credits, AI-voice note, privacy notes. The patient floor.

motion.name: weave-in
motion.purpose: The single authored motion: a done thread or today's cell weaves in left to right.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration and transition-duration 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Global keyboard focus; gold outline on the green header.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.value: 576px max-width, centred, 20px side padding at every width

extensions.scope: Recorded from the patient flow /p/[code]. /clinic, /clinic/slip and /dtam share the tokens but have not been restyled into this world.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one big way to start today: solid Leaf Green, 76px, display-face label with an outline icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><polygon points="6 3 20 12 6 21 6 3" fill="currentColor"/></svg>เริ่มทำการบ้านวันนี้</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-plex-thai, "IBM Plex Sans Thai"), var(--font-looped, "IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped"), sans-serif; min-height: 76px; font-size: 28px; color: #fff; background: var(--brand, #145139); border: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--brand-deep, #0d3a28); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--indigo, #16466e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Step Navigation
components.description: Back (ghost) and Next (primary, 64px) under every question; Next stays disabled until an answer is chosen.

components.name: Yes / No Answer Tiles
components.description: 80px tiles with icon plus word; the selected tile fills solid (red for yes to a red-flag question, green for no) and stays filled.

components.name: Stop Bar
components.description: Fixed to the bottom during every posture: red-outlined 72px stop buttons, three when the posture is standing.

components.html:

  6. ศ

gap: 6px; } .ds-cloth li { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 18px; color: var(--muted, #4a453d); } .ds-cloth b { color: var(--foreground, #1f1b16); font-weight: 600; } .ds-done { border-color: var(--brand, #145139); background: var(--brand-tint, #e3eee7); } .ds-weave { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 10px; background-color: var(--brand, #145139); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 7px, rgb(250 247 240 / 0.7) 7px 8px, transparent 8px 9px, rgb(232 187 31 / 0.95) 9px 11px, transparent 11px 14px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 7px, rgb(250 247 240 / 0.55) 7px 8px, transparent 8px 9px, rgb(232 187 31 / 0.75) 9px 11px, transparent 11px 14px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(22 70 110 / 0.95) 0 6px, transparent 6px 14px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(22 70 110 / 0.7) 0 6px, transparent 6px 14px); animation: ds-weave-in 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-today { border-color: var(--foreground, #1f1b16); outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #e8bb1f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-strike { position: absolute; narrative.northStar: ผ้าขาวม้าที่ทอเองทุกวัน (the loincloth you weave yourself, a day at a time)
narrative.overview:
Each day's homework is one thread, and a week of practice weaves a ผ้าขาวม้า check of เขียวใบแค green, คราม indigo, a thin รงทอง gold thread and ivory. The cloth is how the patient sees progress, and it is information, not a score. There are no streaks, rings, badges or points. Around the cloth the surface is quiet. It has an ivory ground, ink text, one 2px border system, generous rounded panels and no shadows. The shell is a solid green field ending in a woven selvedge strip.

Older Thai eyes and hands set the density. Text is large and set in the looped Thai face, targets are big, and each screen does one thing: one question, one posture, or one outcome. The current item expands and everything else recedes. Safety outranks completion, so stopping is always one tap away, and red belongs only to stopping and 1669.

The world rejects the white health app with progress rings and badges, the government form, and "too Thai" ornament (gold kanok, temple motifs, gold gradients).
keyCharacteristics: Ivory ground, ink text, solid green shell with a woven selvedge along its lower edge.
The weave appears only as data (done days, session threads) and as the selvedge, never behind text.
One state-mark vocabulary for days and threads: woven, bare warp, dashed, red strike, gold ring.
Flat panels with one 2px border system and 20–24px corners. No shadows.
Looped Thai for everything you read, and the loopless display face only at 28px and above.
A single authored motion: a thread weaving in.

rules.name: The Red Is For Stopping Rule
rules.body: Stop Red appears only on stop controls, the 1669 path, the stopped-day strike, and the yes answer to a red-flag question. A screen with no way to stop has no red.

rules.name: The Gold Never Speaks Rule
rules.body: Gold is never a text colour. It rings, fills and threads. Ink sits on it.

rules.name: The Loops For Reading Rule
rules.body: Any text a patient reads as a sentence is set in the looped face. The loopless display face is only for 28px and above.

rules.name: The No Clip Rule
rules.body: Thai stacks marks above and below the line, so text boxes never get a fixed height or `overflow: hidden`, and line-height never drops below 1.25 on Thai text.

rules.name: The One Thing Per Screen Rule
rules.body: Each screen holds one question, one posture or one outcome, with Back and Next (Back is omitted only where there is nowhere to go back to). The question itself is the h1; the counter lives in the header, not above the question.

rules.name: The Stop Bar Rule
rules.body: During a posture the stop controls are fixed at the bottom of the viewport: two buttons, or three when the posture is standing (ปวดแปล๊บ, เวียนหัว, เซ).

rules.name: The Flat Cloth Rule
rules.body: No shadows. If something needs to stand apart, give it a 2px border, a solid field or a tint.

dos: Do use the weave only as data (a done day, a done posture thread) or as the header selvedge.
Do mark state with the one vocabulary: woven for done, bare warp for not yet, dashed for skipped, red strike for stopped for safety, gold ring for today or current.
Do set patient body text at 20px in the looped face, with 1.7 line height.
Do make primary buttons 64–76px, every other target at least 56px, and the 1669 button at least 72px, with 12px between targets.
Do pair every lucide outline icon (stroke 2–2.5) with a Thai text label.
Do give every question and every posture step a listen button in indigo.
Do keep the stop bar fixed at the bottom for the whole posture.
Do keep DTAM credit, the "ดูต้นฉบับ" link and the AI-voice label under every posture.
donts: Don't put the check pattern behind text, as a panel texture or as a page background.
Don't use Stop Red for anything except stopping, 1669, the stopped-day strike and the yes answer to a red-flag question.
Don't add shadows; separate with a 2px border, a solid field or a tint.
Don't show progress as rings, percentages, streaks, badges or points; the cloth is the only progress display at rest.
Don't use gold kanok, temple motifs or gold gradients.
Don't use the loopless display face below 28px.
Don't add motion beyond the weave-in, and never animate the 1669 button.
